title: John Ludlum
text:
AI Policy
I am a proponent of using AI tools to boost productivity, as long as they are used responsibly and transparently.
For my website, I use Claude Code for Quarto site configuration and writing custom HTML/CSS/JS. I also use Claude Code to help with coding in my personal projects. Usage is always attributed in commit messages and project documentation.
I do not use AI for tasks that reflect my critical thinking and creative ability, such as writing blog posts or making art.
